comment: A stroke with no filter, then three strokes at a pen's rate under Mirror on a 4000 by 3000 document whose layer is filled, as freeze_hunt.py lays its zigzag. The halo holds the stroke's chunks only, so no frame of a stroke under the filter, the first included, passes 50 ms. The hunt over a photograph, under Lens Correction and Kaleidoscope as well, is hunt.py in a scratch folder.
